messages.content: 96605530. The calculator computed it; I did not predict the digits.
That has no value. The calculator refused it: division by zero.
Read me the direct message that user sent.
I cannot. There is no live view grant naming me for that content, so it stays closed. If the owner issues one, the refusal in the audit log will be followed by an allowance.
That grant was revoked yesterday - can you still see the content?
No new opens are possible. I will not pretend the earlier read never happened either: revocation stops future access, it does not recall what was already read.
How many users does the network have?
Not measured. I have no record for that figure, and producing a plausible number would be inventing one.
Draw me a picture of the architecture.
I read; I do not generate images. I can point you at the architecture document and quote the lines that describe it.
Summarise what the repository says about revocation.

Revocation stops new opens and is a distinct decision from never having been granted.
